name: payload-model-to-fable
config:
config-version: 8
access:
  api-keys: [client-key-1]
oauth:
  auth-dir: AUTH_DIR
requests:
  payload:
    override:
      - models:
          - name: claude-sonnet-4-6
            protocol: claude
        params:
          model: claude-fable-5-1
    override-raw:
      - models:
          - name: claude-sonnet-4-6
            protocol: claude
        params:
          thinking: '{"type":"adaptive"}'
body: {"model": "claude-sonnet-4-6", "max_tokens": 2048, "system": "You are terse.", "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Summarise the plan in one line"}]}

name: payload-model-to-legacy
config:
config-version: 8
access:
  api-keys: [client-key-1]
oauth:
  auth-dir: AUTH_DIR
requests:
  payload:
    override:
      - models:
          - name: claude-sonnet-5
            protocol: claude
        params:
          model: claude-sonnet-4-5
body: {"model": "claude-sonnet-5", "max_tokens": 2048, "thinking": {"type": "adaptive"}, "system": [{"type": "text", "text": "Follow the house style."}], "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Write a haiku about rivers"}]}

name: payload-default-reads-original
config:
config-version: 8
access:
  api-keys: [client-key-1]
oauth:
  auth-dir: AUTH_DIR
requests:

      - models:

name: payload-filter-fable
config:
config-version: 8
access:
  api-keys: [client-key-1]
oauth:
  auth-dir: AUTH_DIR
requests:
  payload:
    filter:
      - models:
          - name: claude-fable-5-1
            protocol: claude
        params:
          - fallbacks
          - thinking.display

name: payload-count-upstream
config:
config-version: 8
access:
  api-keys: [client-key-1]
oauth:
  auth-dir: AUTH_DIR
requests:
  payload:
    override:
      - models:
          - name: claude-opus-5-5
            protocol: claude
        params:
          system: Configured count system
    default-raw:
      - models:
          - name: claude-opus-5-5
            protocol: claude
        params:
          diagnostics: '{"rule":true}'
    filter:
      - models:
          - name: claude-opus-5-5
            protocol: claude
        params:
          - tools.1

name: payload-count-local
config:
config-version: 8
access:
  api-keys: [client-key-1]
oauth:
  auth-dir: AUTH_DIR
api-keys:
  claude:
    - base-url: http://gateway.invalid
      keys:
        - api-key: gw-FAKE-KEY
          fingerprint-profile: claude-code-cli
          headers:
            X-Team: alpha
            X-Echo: $X-Source
requests:
  payload:
    override:
      - models:
          - name: claude-opus-5-5
            protocol: claude
        params:
          system: Configured count system
    default-raw:
      - models:
          - name: claude-opus-5-5
            protocol: claude
        params:
          diagnostics: '{"rule":true}'
    filter:
      - models:
          - name: claude-opus-5-5
            protocol: claude
        params:
          - tools.1
